verdict.rationale: Statsig documents layered targeting rules on gates, and its tutorial targets gates by platform and to internal testers, so attribute-based rule targeting is evidenced. Reusable segments are never explicitly documented, which leaves half the story unproven. Missing for 10: documented reusable segments, detail on the supported attribute and operator types in targeting rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: You can also layer multiple targeting rules and set overrides to force specific users into a variant for testing or QA.
This tutorial creates a feature gate, targets mobile platforms and internal testers, then checks it live with the JavaScript SDK in your browser console.
set up Feature Gate overrides to allow specific users to bypass the gate.
